title: Gate spell concentration mechanics against duration semantics
description:
Finding source:
- Protection from Evil and Good copied its duration faithfully but mechanics.concentration was false due to the no-comma source wording.
- Existing gates did not cross-check derived flag semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add pack-wide check over all 319 spells: concentration duration semantics must match mechanics.concentration.
- Include no-comma and comma forms.
- Report spell key, duration, derived value, and expected value on mismatch.
close_reason: Satisfied by PR #383 (with eshyra-o9bd.18.2): spell-concentration-flag check covers all spells both directions, accepts comma/no-comma forms, reports key/duration/derived/expected.
